reviewed.title: vite: `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths

exception.why: server.fs.deny bypass via Windows alternate path forms (8.3 names / ADS). The artifact's Vite dev server runs only on the Linux workspace container; the artifact has no production service (artifact.toml defines a development run only), so the Windows path forms cannot reach it.

reviewed.title: esbuild enables any website to send any requests to the development server and read the response

exception.why: The advisory concerns esbuild's own serve() development server answering cross-origin requests. Vite 5 bundles esbuild only as a transform/pre-bundle library and never starts esbuild's serve mode, so the vulnerable server is not running.

reviewed.title: Vite Vulnerable to Path Traversal in Optimized Deps `.map` Handling

exception.why: Path traversal in optimized-deps .map handling affects a running Vite DEV server only. This artifact is never built into or served by the published app (no production service in artifact.toml); exposure is limited to the workspace dev preview while it is open. Remove when the shared Vite major upgrade lands.

reviewed.title: launch-editor: NTLMv2 hash disclosure via UNC path handling on Windows

exception.why: launch-editor NTLMv2 hash disclosure through UNC paths is Windows-only (SMB authentication on a Windows host). The dev server runs on Linux and no production service exists for this artifact.
